lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit displays a series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four horizontal rows, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with inter-spot distances appearing consistent across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid, most prominent in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, high-contrast linear ridge is visible running longitudinally along the upper flank, originating posterior to the gill region and terminating near the base of the first dorsal fin, marked by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light above to dark below.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and distal tip of the primary pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly clustered high-luminance spots compared to the density observed on the main lateral flank.
